title: plugin-auth: seven refusals and one outage thrown from better-auth hooks carry no ADR-0112 code, the same gap #23945 closes for the invitation role cap
body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): a product defect with named producers on public doors. This is the collector card for the family: one card over every position, not single-point cards. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`. It comes from the contract review of PR #24238 (`6244382751`, escalation (a)), which closes the same gap for the invitation role cap (#23945). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and `area:*` are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth`). Any code outside the standard ADR-0112 set must first be registered in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`. That half is the spec seat's, split as #24082 / #23945 were split.

## The family, enumerated on `origin/main` `7715d049e`

Every `new APIError(` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/**` outside test files: 25 throws, 8 of them with no `code`. One of the 8 is the invitation role cap's (`auth-manager.ts:3496`), which PR #24238 fixes. The remaining 7, all in `auth-manager.ts`, are:

| line | status | where it is thrown | what it refuses |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `:1357` | 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | `slugGuardReadFaultApiError`, update-organization | the slug guard's read could not answer |
| `:3435` | 400 `BAD_REQUEST` | the create-organization hook | the reserved `__global__` id or slug |
| `:3443` | 403 `FORBIDDEN` | the create-organization hook | creating more organizations is disabled on this deployment |
| `:3506` | 403 `FORBIDDEN` | the invitation placement hook | placement needs the delegated-administration runtime |
| `:3524` | 403 `FORBIDDEN` | the invitation placement hook | placement outside the issuer's delegated scope (the message is relayed from `err?.message`) |
| `:3634` | 403 `FORBIDDEN` | update-organization's slug guard | changing a slug while active environments reference it |
| `:5727` | 429 `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` | `assertPhoneOtpSendAllowed` | the phone OTP send rate limit |

Without a `code`, better-auth serialises each body as `message` alone. A client, the console among them, can only show or pattern-match English prose, and on the same doors better-auth's own refusals do carry codes. The same is true of this lane's `remove-member` refusal (`:7700`–`:7706`).

## Wanted

- Each of the seven carries a stable ADR-0112 `code`: a standard code where one fits (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` for the outage, the rate-limit code for `:5727`), or a code registered in the ledger, typed `RegisteredErrorCode` at the throw, as #23945 does.
- One pin enumerates every `new APIError(` in `plugin-auth/src` and requires a `code`, so the next one cannot ship without it. It is a test in the package; ⛔ no new CI gate. The enumeration above is its control.
- Wire pins where a door reaches the throw on demand (`:3443` on a single-organization posture, `:3634`, `:5727`). Unit pins for the rest, each with a sentence on why.

## Dedupe

- #23945 is the invitation cap's single point, fixed by PR #24238.
- A REST scan of the 814 most recently updated objectstack issues (open and closed) for `slugGuardReadFaultApiError`, "message only" and "no code" beside `APIError` found 4 hits: PR #24238 and #23945 (the cap), and two closed cards on other doors, #23991 (core's API-key refusal) and #23528 (the `/mcp` bridge). None covers these seven.

Dedupe words: plugin-auth APIError no code; better-auth hook refusal message only; ADR-0112 code organization create slug guard phone otp.
